# Full-width Settings, Reviewers and Runs pages, and a graph-manager favicon

## What to build

Two small graph-manager web fixes (spec goals **MR-10** and **MR-11**, section "graph-manager UI fixes").

1. **Full width (MR-10).** The Settings, Reviewers and Runs pages stop at a fixed width (`max-width: 980px / 1100px / 1240px`) and leave the right side of a wide window empty. Remove those three caps so the page content reaches the right edge of the main area, minus the page padding (`.page` in `ui/base.css:31` pads `var(--space-7)` left/right). No child of these three pages may keep a narrower cap that leaves the right side empty; forms and cards *inside* a page (drawers, dialogs, the empty-state body) keep their own widths.
2. **Favicon (MR-11).** Add `apps/graph-manager/src/web/public/favicon.svg`: the `logo` mark of `ui/Icon.tsx` (lines 130–139) as a static SVG with fixed colors — `#16171a` square and `#ffffff` graph, and under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` a `#ecedef` square and `#16181b` graph. Link it from `src/web/index.html` with `<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg" />`. Vite copies `src/web/public/` (its default `publicDir`, since `root` is `src/web`) to the root of `dist/web/`, the server serves it as `GET /favicon.svg` without login, the root build copies `dist/web` into the npm package (`packages/graph-execution/dist/manager/web/`), and the Docker image is built with that root build, so the file ships everywhere without new build steps. Add regression tests that pin each of these links.

Not in this task: anything about projects (later tasks add a Projects page; do not add it here).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/multi-repo.md` — section "graph-manager UI fixes (MR-10, MR-11)" and the two acceptance criteria at the end of "graph-manager".
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.css` (line 2) — `.settings-page { max-width: 980px; }`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Reviewers.css` (line 2) — `.reviewers-page { max-width: 1100px; }`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.css` (line 2) — `.runs-page { max-width: 1240px; }`. Lines 44–48: the runs table grid has one `fr` column, so it already stretches; line 29/31 (`.runs-ws-select` max-width 100% / 260px) and line 65 (`.runs-progress` max-width 72px) are control widths, keep them.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/base.css` (lines 31–34) — `.page` padding and `.page-header { max-width: none }`; (line 205) `.dialog` max-width 420px, (line 245) `.empty-state-body` max-width 320px — keep both.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/styles.css` (lines 48, 70, 79–83) — legacy rules with `max-width: 900px` (`.forge-cards`, `.start-run`, `.page-header`, `.clone-panel`, `.repo-list`, `.workspace-list`). `grep -rn` shows none of those class names is used by a `.tsx` file any more except `.page-header`, whose cap `ui/base.css:32` overrides (`main.tsx` imports `styles.css` before `ui/base.css`). Leave them alone unless you find a use on one of the three pages.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` (lines 173–197), `pages/Reviewers.tsx` (line 146), `pages/Runs.tsx` (lines 348–349) — the page roots `section.page.settings-page`, `section.page.reviewers-page`, `section.page.runs-page`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/Icon.tsx` (lines 127–139) — the `logo` SVG: `viewBox="0 0 22 22"`, `rect x=1 y=1 w=20 h=20 rx=5 fill=var(--fg)`, three circles r=2 at (7,7.5) (15,7.5) (11,15) `fill=var(--sf)`, path `M7 9.5 10 13.3M15 9.5 12 13.3` stroke `var(--sf)` width 1.4.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/index.html` (lines 1–25) — add the link inside `<head>` after `<title>`.
- `apps/graph-manager/vite.config.ts` (lines 1–10) — `root: "src/web"`, `build.outDir: "../../dist/web"`; no `publicDir` set, so the default `src/web/public` applies. Do not change this file.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 159–168) — `@fastify/static` is registered on `webDir` with `wildcard: false`, which registers one GET route per file that exists at startup (so `dist/web/favicon.svg` becomes `GET /favicon.svg`); the not-found handler serves `index.html` for any other GET (SPA fallback), so a missing favicon would answer 200 **text/html** — the tests must check the content type.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.ts` (lines 59–67) — `needsAuth`: only `/api/*` and run views need a session, so `/favicon.svg` is public already. No change needed; pin it with a test.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.test.ts` (lines 14–57) — builds the app with a temp `webDir` holding `index.html` and `app.js`; the `/healthz` test (lines 52–57) is the pattern for a public URL.
- `packages/graph-execution/scripts/bundle-manager.mjs` (lines 19–23) — copies the whole `apps/graph-manager/dist/web` into `dist/manager/web` (filtering only `.test.` files), so `favicon.svg` is bundled.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/manager/bundle.test.ts` (lines 66–75) — the `npm pack --dry-run` test lists expected tarball paths; add `dist/manager/web/favicon.svg`.
- `apps/graph-manager/Dockerfile` (lines 16–17) and the root `.dockerignore` — the image runs the root `npm run build` on `COPY . .`; `.dockerignore` excludes `**/dist`, `docs`, tests, not `src/web/public`. No Dockerfile change needed.
- `TESTING.md` "graph-manager" section (around lines 126–147) and "Web view (agent-browser)" (lines 54–75) — how to start graph-manager and look at it with `agent-browser`.

## Patterns to follow

The favicon, written out (keep the geometry identical to `Icon.tsx`):

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none">
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #16171a; }
    .dot { fill: #ffffff; }
    .edge { stroke: #ffffff; }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      .bg { fill: #ecedef; }
      .dot { fill: #16181b; }
      .edge { stroke: #16181b; }
    }
  </style>
  <rect class="bg" x="1" y="1" width="20" height="20" rx="5" />
  <circle class="dot" cx="7" cy="7.5" r="2" />
  <circle class="dot" cx="15" cy="7.5" r="2" />
  <circle class="dot" cx="11" cy="15" r="2" />
  <path class="edge" d="M7 9.5 10 13.3M15 9.5 12 13.3" stroke-width="1.4" />
</svg>
```

A public URL test, in the style of `auth.test.ts:52-57`:

```ts
it("serves /favicon.svg as an SVG without a cookie", async () => {
  const res = await app.inject({ url: "/favicon.svg" });
  expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200);
  expect(String(res.headers["content-type"])).toMatch(/^image\/svg\+xml/);
  expect(needsAuth("GET", "/favicon.svg")).toBe(false);
});
```

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.css`, `pages/Reviewers.css`, `pages/Runs.css`
- **IMPLEMENT**: delete the `max-width` from `.settings-page` (line 2), `.reviewers-page` (line 2) and `.runs-page` (line 2). If a rule becomes empty, delete the line; keep the comment on line 1.
- **GOTCHA**: then grep each CSS file and its page component (`Settings.tsx` + `SandboxCard.tsx`, `SandboxImage.tsx`, `RecipeEditor.tsx`; `Reviewers.tsx`; `Runs.tsx`) for `max-width` / `maxWidth` on a direct child that would leave the right side empty. At the time of writing there is none (the remaining ones are controls, drawers, the dialog and the empty state, which stay). Do not touch `pages/Workspaces.css` or `pages/Terminals.css`.
- **VALIDATE**: `grep -n "max-width" apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/{Settings,Reviewers,Runs}.css` shows no rule on `.settings-page`, `.reviewers-page` or `.runs-page`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/public/favicon.svg`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the SVG above, UTF-8, LF line ends, ending with a newline.
- **GOTCHA**: `src/web/public` does not exist yet; create the folder. Do not import the file from TS/CSS: Vite copies `public/` verbatim and leaves `href="/favicon.svg"` in `index.html` as is.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/index.html`
- **IMPLEMENT**: add `<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg" />` on its own line after `<title>graph-manager</title>` (line 6), same 4-space indent.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/favicon.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** (node environment; read the files with `readFileSync(new URL("../web/public/favicon.svg", import.meta.url), "utf8")` and `new URL("../web/index.html", import.meta.url)`, like `src/server/dockerfile.test.ts:5` reads `../../Dockerfile`):
  - `index.html` contains `<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg" />`.
  - `favicon.svg` starts with `<svg`, has `viewBox="0 0 22 22"`, contains `#16171a`, `#ffffff`, `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, `#ecedef` and `#16181b`, and contains no `var(` (fixed colors only; a CSS variable does not resolve in a favicon).
- **PATTERN**: `apps/graph-manager/src/server/dockerfile.test.ts:1-16`.
- **GOTCHA**: put it under `src/server/`, not `src/web/`: `tsconfig.web.json` type-checks `src/web/**/*.ts` test files too with only `vite/client` types, and no web file imports `node:*` (a `node:fs` import there may fail `npm run typecheck`). `src/server/*.test.ts` are excluded from `tsconfig.json` and run under vitest with Node. Use `URL`s (no `\`), so the test also runs on Windows; compare with `toContain`, not whole-file equality (Windows checkouts may have CRLF).

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/auth.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `beforeEach` (lines 14–21) also write `path.join(webDir, "favicon.svg")` with a small `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"/>`. Add the test from "Patterns to follow" to the `describe("auth")` block. Also assert that a GET of `/favicon.svg` after logging in still answers 200 (no redirect/401 either way).
- **GOTCHA**: the file must be written before `buildApp`: `@fastify/static` with `wildcard: false` only routes files present when it registers.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/auth src/server/favicon`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/manager/bundle.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: add `"dist/manager/web/favicon.svg"` to the `expected` list at line 71 (the describe is skipped unless the root build ran; CI runs it after `npm run build`).

### UPDATE `TESTING.md` (graph-manager section, the bullet list after the curl commands, ~line 141)
- **IMPLEMENT**: one bullet: "`curl -sI http://127.0.0.1:7420/favicon.svg` without a cookie answers 200 `image/svg+xml`; the browser tab shows the graph-manager logo (dark square on a light browser theme, light square on a dark one). Settings, Reviewers and Runs fill the main area at any width."

## Look at it in a browser (required: TESTING.md says UI changes must be seen by you)

Use `agent-browser` as in TESTING.md "Web view (agent-browser)" and "graph-manager":

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager
ls apps/graph-manager/dist/web/favicon.svg                                  # copied by vite
GM_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
GM_PASSWORD=pw GM_PORT=7430 GM_DATA_DIR=$GM_DIR/data GM_WORKSPACES_DIR=$GM_DIR/ws \
  node apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js > $GM_DIR/server.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > $GM_DIR/pid
curl -sI http://127.0.0.1:7430/favicon.svg | head -5                         # 200, content-type: image/svg+xml, no cookie
agent-browser set viewport 2560 1200
agent-browser open http://127.0.0.1:7430/
agent-browser snapshot -i                                                     # log in with pw (fill the password field, press Log in)
agent-browser eval 'document.querySelector("link[rel=icon]").href'           # http://127.0.0.1:7430/favicon.svg
for p in runs reviewers settings; do
  agent-browser open http://127.0.0.1:7430/$p
  agent-browser eval '(() => { const page = document.querySelector(".page"); const main = document.querySelector(".gm-main").getBoundingClientRect(); const pr = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(page).paddingRight); const kids = [...page.children].map(c => c.getBoundingClientRect().right); return Math.round(main.right - pr - Math.max(...kids)); })()'
  agent-browser screenshot $GM_DIR/$p-2560.png                               # read it and LOOK: content reaches the right side
done
agent-browser set viewport 800 700 && agent-browser open http://127.0.0.1:7430/runs
agent-browser eval 'document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth'       # 0: no horizontal scroll on small screens
agent-browser close
kill $(cat $GM_DIR/pid)
```

Expected: the `eval` per page prints `0` (give or take a pixel or the scrollbar width): the widest child of the page ends at the right padding of the main area. Before the change, Runs printed about 1000 at 2560 px. Put the three numbers and the screenshot paths in your report. Use another port if 7430 is taken; stop the server by its PID.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `.settings-page`, `.reviewers-page` and `.runs-page` have no `max-width`; at a 2560×1200 viewport the Runs table/cards, the Reviewers list and the Settings cards reach the right edge of the main area minus the page padding (the `eval` above prints ~0 for each page).
- [ ] At 800 px wide there is no horizontal page scroll on these three pages.
- [ ] `apps/graph-manager/src/web/public/favicon.svg` exists with the logo geometry and the fixed light/dark colors; `index.html` links it.
- [ ] After `npm run build -w graph-manager`, `apps/graph-manager/dist/web/favicon.svg` exists, and `GET /favicon.svg` answers 200 `image/svg+xml` without a session cookie.
- [ ] `src/server/favicon.test.ts` and the new `auth.test.ts` case exist and pass; `bundle.test.ts` lists `dist/manager/web/favicon.svg`.
- [ ] No change to `vite.config.ts`, `app.ts`, `auth.ts`, the bundle script or the Dockerfile is needed (if one turns out to be needed, explain why in the commit).
- [ ] All existing graph-manager tests still pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/auth src/server/favicon src/web/Settings src/web/pages/Reviewers src/web/pages/Runs
npm run build && npm test -w graph-execution -- src/manager/bundle
```
